fagrapport113_Wolves2016-2026

Repository containing the input data, R script, figures, tables and raster density maps from the following technical report:

Dupont, P., Milleret, C., Semper-Pascual, A., Brøseth, H., Flagstad, Ø., Kindberg, J., Svensson,L., and Bischof, R., 2026. Estimates of wolf density, abundance, and population dynamics in Sweden and Norway, 2016/17–2025/26 - MINA fagrapport 113. 37 pp. PDF LINK
